record.paper_title: Positive and free boundary solutions to singular nonlinear elliptic problems with absorption: an overview and open problems
record.original_question: Under the same assumptions, Ilyasov and Egorov also construct a nonnegative solution u_λ ≥ 0 with ∂u_λ/∂n = 0 on ∂Ω. Is this second solution necessarily strictly positive in Ω?

artifact.category_tag: singular semilinear elliptic equations with absorption
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return any publication directly resolving whether the second solution $u_\lambda$ (the one satisfying $\partial u_\lambda/\partial \mathbf{n} = 0$ on $\partial\Omega$) constructed by Il'yasov and Egorov for the strong absorption problem is necessarily strictly positive in $\Omega$. Related work by Díaz, Hernández and Il'yasov on existence of positive and compact-support solutions for this spectral problem is available, but no source consulted confirms or refutes strict positivity of this second branch. The status is therefore inconclusive.

status_evidence.title: Branches of positive and free boundary solutions for some singular quasilinear elliptic problems
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and multiplicity of solutions, strictly positive or nonnegative with a free boundary, for quasilinear eigenvalue problems with possibly singular terms.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of free-boundary (compact support) solutions and strictly positive solutions is studied, but strict positivity of the overdetermined branch is not generally established.

status_evidence.title: Positive and Free Boundary Solutions to Singular Nonlinear Elliptic Problems with Absorption: An Overview and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of recent results and open problems concerning existence and multiplicity of positive and/or compact support solutions to semilinear elliptic equations with singular absorption terms.
status_evidence.claim: The status of strict positivity for the second (overdetermined) solution is listed among open problems in this area.
